game:worldattribute-RWEnableRivulets-des: Enable or disable mountainside rivulets (rapids are always enabled)
game:worldattribute-RWEnableLakeExtensio: If enabled, new water sources will be created when digging at the border of a lake, allowing the creation of navigable canals
game:worldattribute-RWFlowSearchDistance: The maximum distance water looks ahead when seeking downward paths. Smaller numbers produce more wetlands, bigger numbers produce more flowing streams
